evidence: There were three tendons in my ankle that needed to be repaired and my heel needed to be. And so I wasn't able to do a lot of the stuff that I'm, I want to do. And so I ended up having surgery in December.
I got to re-address my balance in my right foot, because obviously I wasn't walking on it for like three months.
I'm finally recovered from that and finally walking fully and all that other stuff. So, and I'm getting my hormones under control. So I think now is probably the best time to do that.
